### A Long-Awaited Insight
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/a-long-awaited-insight
Passage: Ecclesiastes 12:1
Points:
- Discovering life's true purpose often requires learning hard lessons through personal experience.
- Clarity, spiritual focus, and genuine perspective arrive when a person surrenders to God.
- In Scripture, remembering God means taking decisive action on His behalf.
- Obeying God's Word rather than our own impulses is the core of true joy.
- Committing to the Creator in youth provides solid grounding before old age sets in.

### When Trouble Divides Us
Author: Carla Barnhill
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/niv-devotions-for-couples/niv-devotions-for-couples-week-of-feb-8.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 12:1
Points:
- Scripture warns that difficult seasons of trouble are certain to arrive for everyone.
- Outside exhaustion and emotional crises can strain marital love and patience.
- Sustaining love during overwhelming trials relies on God's strength rather than human willpower.
- Hard times require intentionally recalling the admirable qualities of your spouse.
- Preparing spiritually and emotionally during good days creates a reservoir for adversity.
